label: kizuna_history_b_02
text: Are you perhaps interested in the rest of the old\ntale I told you in class?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_b_03
text: Heh. It is...convenient that you would take the\nbait I presented in class.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_b_04
text: Don’t lie to me. Your desire to fulfill your\nintellectual curiosity is made plain as day by that\r\nlook on your face.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_b_05
text: A vessel, a sword, a set of tablets, and a set of\nbeads... After obtaining these four treasures, the\r\nking’s castle was destroyed. Why, you ask?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_b_06
text: Because these four treasures were actually\nfour Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_b_07
text: As these Pokémon were passed from human hand\nto human hand as treasures, they slowly became\r\ntainted by hubris and greed.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_b_08
text: Finally, after coming in contact with the rapacity\nof the king at that time, they awakened as\r\ndisasters and began to rampage out of control.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_b_09
text: The king called for renowned Pokémon wielders\nto defend the country and, after a fierce battle,\r\nthese incarnations of disaster were quelled.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_b_10
text: It is said that these four Pokémon were then\nsealed away somewhere in Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_b_11
text: So, what do you think? Would you say this story\nis just make-believe?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_b_12
text: What?! Where’s your sense of adventure?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_b_14
text: I have read many historical disaster reports,\npersonal journals, and the like.\c\nThere is much to support the truth of this story.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_b_15
text: If I am able to prove the story’s veracity myself,\nI will be sure to let you know.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_b_system_01
text: You became even closer with Ms. Raifort!
